conclusion: For p > 3 prime and even e >= 2 with ord(omega^e)=6, A_p^[-e]=0 and K_{2e}(Z){p}=0, without an upper weight restriction. With the accepted orders 1,2,3,4, the remaining rational order is 5 or at least 7.
whole_proof_checks: Evenness and order six give the real cyclic sextic field of prime conductor p and p congruent to 1 modulo 12.
The ordinary Hilbert-class argument gives the integral positive quotient J=h6/(h2 h3), not merely a real-valued ratio.
The sign adjustment identifies the relative units of norms +/-1 modulo torsion with Gras exact norm-one module and preserves the regulator.
The general Gras bound has R* >= (3/16) log^2((p-20)/4), with no special-family or signature condition.
The analytic class-number residues and determinant give exactly J=Q p |L(1,chi)|^2/(48 R*), Q in {1,3,4,12}.
The primitive-even L bound has kappa0=2+gamma-log(4 pi), and combining all factors yields p/3 times the squared logarithm ratio.
For p >= 2^31, the exact inequalities t>20, log5<2 and kappa0<1 give J < (49/108)p < p.
Accepted quadratic/cubic class bounds and integer J imply p does not divide h6.
Prime-to-p norm and extension kill the H-invariant p-class group, hence the required character component; accepted K17-(K2) gives every periodic weight.
